name: Old School Gaming
summary:
Old School Gaming is game night the way it used to be: a felt-topped walnut table right in your own room, through mixed reality. Pick a game from the phone book in an old wooden phone booth, and the operator puts you through.

THIRTEEN GAMES
- Texas Hold'em, Spades, Euchre and Sets n Runs rummy
- Mexican Train dominoes
- Chess and checkers, saved after every move
- Race Home: race four pawns home
- Sketch & Guess: draw in the air while everyone calls out guesses (Easy, Medium or Hard)
- Four in a Row for up
